content:
maria_cs: quick sync — Tenon private deploy hitting 3 production blockers we need to clear before handoff: VPC peering routing, KMS key access for cross-account logs, and audit-log delivery to their SIEM. posting notes and owners.

jordan_eng: thanks. what’s the exact routing symptom?

maria_cs: intermittent 502s from their app to the inference endpoint when traffic goes via the transit-gw peering. packets drop on larger payloads. looks like MTU / MSS or iptables conntrack.

aisha_se: seen that before — when you see drops on larger payloads, MTU mismatch on the TGW attachment or a NAT gateway with PMTU blackhole. can we confirm traceroute + tcpdump from our ENI?

maria_cs: yes, jordan ran a quick pcap and saw ICMP frag-needed not returning. attaching snippet: ```traceroute to 10.200.3.12, mtu 1500, icmp frag-needed from 100.64.0.5```

jordan_eng: action: ben to validate TGW attachment MTU and check any iptables MSS clamp on the proxy. if we need, enable MSS clamp on the customer NAT instance. assigning @ben_infra.

ben_infra: taking it. quick note on IAM/KMS — Tenon asked us to grant a cross-account role in their audit account to read CloudTrail S3 objects encrypted with their KMS key. current key policy denies external principals by default.

aisha_se: for KMS recommend using a minimal key policy + grant that limits to `arn:aws:iam::TENON_ACC:role/RedwoodLogFetcher` and adds an explicit `kms:Decrypt` for GetObject on the S3 SSE-KMS envelope. also need `s3:GetObject` on the bucket policy.

maria_cs: Tenon compliance wants key rotation window documented and the ability to rotate annually. they also asked about HSM-backed keys (we said bring-your-own-key boxed option exists for Private).

sam_support: from renewal risk POV — legal needs confirmation of at-rest encryption ownership. if we can’t produce a clear cross-account access plan by EOD Friday, customer flagged contract renewal risk.

maria_cs: noted. can we put a blocker flag on the account health dashboard and schedule exec touchpoint if unresolved?

ben_infra: KMS plan: update key policy + create a dedicated grant. Terraform example I’ll push to the Tenon repo: ```resource "aws_kms_key" "tenon_logs" {description = "Tenon CloudTrail logs" policy = <<POLICY ... POLCIY> } resource "aws_kms_grant" "redwood_fetcher" {grantee_principal = "arn:aws:iam::TENON_ACC:role/RedwoodLogFetcher" operations = ["Decrypt"] }``` will add perms for `kms:GenerateDataKey` too.

jordan_eng: for audit logs we also need S3 bucket notifications to their SIEM via Kinesis or direct S3 replication? Tenon prefers push to their Splunk ingestion endpoint.

aisha_se: Splunk HTTP Event Collector is fine, but we'll need an outbound NAT + egress IP allowlist. Tenon must add those IPs to their firewall allowlist.

maria_cs: FYI they already have a allowlist ticket open (ref: TEN-4532). We should coordinate with Tenon security team.

sam_support: scheduling: 1) Ben fixes TGW MTU check, 2) Ben updates KMS key policy + grant, 3) Jordan validates S3 -> Splunk pipeline and outbound NAT IPs, 4) Maria to confirm docs for rotation and SLA for log availability. can we target tom EOD for 1+2, and Thu EOD for 3+4?

ben_infra: ok for 1 today. will open a PR for KMS changes and tag @maria_cs for review.

jordan_eng: I’ll prototype a lightweight Lambda forwarder to post S3 objects to the HEC endpoint if direct replication is slow — small warm path for immediate post-cutover.

maria_cs: great. one more: Tenon asked for audit-log retention of 2 years for regulatory reasons; our default is 90 days. legal + product OK with 2-year retention for an add-on — need pricing sign-off. flagging finance for the add-on quote. :money_with_wings:

sam_support: tagging @deploy-bot to record this as an account health risk and create a tracker ticket.

deploy-bot: [ticket created] CS-9853 Tenon private deploy blockers & renewal risk — owners: ben_infra, jordan_eng, maria_cs, sam_support — due 2026-03-25.

maria_cs: thanks. please post PR links and any test artifacts here. small wins: TGW MTU fix will likely resolve the 502s. KMS grant + S3 policy will resolve the access hole.

ben_infra: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/tenon/infra/pulls/72 — includes kms_grant and mtu_check script. asking for review.

aisha_se: quick checklist for handoff: network (MTU + flow logs), IAM (trust policy + roles), KMS (policy + rotation doc), logs (S3 replication/forwarder + retention), egress IPs, compliance signoff.

maria_cs: +1. will run a 30m ops handoff tomorrow 10am PT with Tenon security and engineering. invite sent. :calendar: 

sam_support: marking this as medium renewal risk until all items complete. will escalate if any slip past next Tuesday. :warning:

maria_cs: closing for now — thanks everyone, ping here with updates.
